snippet.title: Roadside Research Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Cybernetic Walrus and Oro Interactive are excited to announce the demo of Roadside Research, a 1 to 4 player co-op gas station simulator. Except you’re aliens. And undercover. Do very human things like restocking shelves while preparing for the invasion. Just don’t get caught.

Play the DEMO: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3911640/Roadside_Research_Demo/
Wishlist FULL GAME: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3643170/Roadside_Research/

Join the Discord: https://discord.com/invite/XGef9H8Rk4
